core.title: Swirl Forged Iron Lever Set With Clover Rose, Acorn IUJBI

text.description_html:
Acorn IUJBI / IUKBI, Black Iron Swirl Lever With Clover Rose

Hand forged, this Acorn made black iron door lever's unique swirled shaped paired with the clover rose makes it not only beautiful but authentic looking as well. It will fit all standard pre-drilled doors 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick with backsets of 2-3/8" or 2-3/4".

Features and Specifications of the Iron Art Door Lever Set:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Lever Length: 4-1/2"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Rose Diameter: 3-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" or 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Sets are suitable for predrilled doors.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior lever engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior lever. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
